description: Lunar 1.5 e-commerce on top of laravel/base + laravel/inertia-vue (Inertia storefront). Lunar 1.x stable pulls Filament 4 and owns its own admin panel (registered at /admin in AppServiceProvider through LunarPanel), so this variant does NOT include laravel/filament; Filament 5 and Lunar 1.x cannot be installed together. There is no Lunar guideline layer yet (package/lunar is not written, esoul-guidelines skips it): plan G3 writes it from the first Lunar project (Indcom), until then the Laravel rules apply and Lunar specifics are decided in ADRs. Overwrites app/Domain/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php and app/Infrastructure/Models/User.php (LunarUser). After creating the app: `php artisan migrate`, `php artisan lunar:install` (default language, currency, channel, tax class and the first admin). Lunar config is not published; run `php artisan vendor:publish --tag=lunar` when it needs changing.
